executions.why_superseded: Its normalisation-free shape diagnostic used the linearised model Pwrong = Q + K*J, which is invalid wherever the min(1,.) clip of (4.22) binds - there J is dominated by the clipped region and (measured - Q)/J is not the implied scale. The same defect affected its free-exponent scan. The diagnostic was replaced by an exact per-score bisection on the clipped model, and the exponent scan by the exact model, and the script was re-run.

free-exponent diagnostic: reported best-fitting p = 21.0 (n=43) and 20.5 (n=50) under the invalid linear form; the exact scan in execution 2 gives 24.0 and 22.0.

observations_summary.note: Observations only. No conclusion about whether Approximation 4.9 is validated or refuted is drawn here or anywhere in this package; that judgement belongs to the Reviewer and the Coordinator.
observations_summary.divergence_direction: Prediction above measurement over the lower band, maximum +1.516 bits at score 471 (n=43) and +1.710 bits at score 420 (n=50), both in the crossover region where the D component and the parameter-free noise component are comparable; sign change at score 888 (n=43) and 1090 (n=50); prediction below measurement from there to the counting floor, mean about -0.2 bits and up to -0.68/-0.64 bits within the pooled-count >= 10 region.
observations_summary.normalisation_free_shape: The scale that reproduces the measurement score-by-score drifts by only 1.150 bits over scores 643-1492 (n=43) and 1.238 bits over 600-1968 (n=50), non-monotonically, across the K-sensitive part of the band.
observations_summary.structural_mismatch_at_the_bottom: For scores 0-126 (n=43) and 0-133 (n=50) the measurement lies below the model's parameter-free noise floor P(N(0,N/2) >= T), so no K >= 0 reproduces it. Maximum shortfall 0.0037 and 0.0069 bits.
observations_summary.parameter_free_component: P(N(0,N/2) >= T) alone tracks the measurement within 0.1 bit to score 322/273, 0.5 bit to 469/401, 1 bit to 525/460, and is 149.99/265.56 bits below it at the counting floor.
observations_summary.family_control: The one-parameter family is not degenerate: rms residual is 1.96 bits at exponent p=10 and 3.63 bits at p=40 (n=43), against 0.692 at the archived-integer p=26 and 0.454 at the best scanned p=24. n=50: 2.35 at p=10, 4.38 at p=40, 0.694 at the archived p=24.5, 0.438 at the best p=22.

files_not_compared.reason: It holds 4000 raw good-guess scores, not a wrong-guess survival curve. Approximation 4.9 is the wrong-guess statement (Approximation 4.8 is the good-guess one), so the F1 comparison is not defined for it. Recorded in comparison_results.json -> files_not_compared[0].

Not present in this repository. It exists here only as a header extract and a sha256 in the input manifest, so there is no survival column to compare against. This is archival defect A3 recorded in EV-MLKEM-018 and it remains open.

anomalies: Erratum in a descriptive string, not in any computed value: the parameter ledger entry for delta(beta_bkz) - in approx49_comparison.py and therefore in comparison_results.json - gives the delta exponent for the n=50 file as 1394; the correct value is beta_sieve*(m+n_lat-beta_sieve) = 41*41 = 1681. delta is unavailable and is absorbed into the free scale K, so no reported number changes. Not repaired by re-running, to keep the executed script byte-consistent with its own recorded output under a maximum_runs: 1 budget; corrected in comparison_report.md sections 2 and 6.

Archived-source disagreement on nb_iteration: the n=50 file header says 6000, the Fig 4.1 caption says 4000 iterations for both panels. Header used; the counting floor 2^-36.28941479 depends on this choice (with 4000 it would be 2^-35.70445229).
Archived-source disagreement on d_lat: header avg_dlat 41.068986 / 57.889159 vs caption 42.00 / 58.60 (2.3% / 1.2%). d_lat enters only through the unavailable scale K, so it does not propagate here.

Difference from EV-MLKEM-018 on the Gaussian excess at the counting floor: 149.99 bits here versus 150.51 bits there, for the n=43 file. This run uses sigma = sqrt(avg_N/2) = 113.9539 from the archived header; that record used the measured sigma = 113.7914. Same file, different estimator; recorded, not resolved.

Difference from EV-MLKEM-018 on the Pgood median: 11964.802334 here versus 11964.473718 there. On 4000 values this run takes the lower central order statistic rather than the average of the two; recorded, not resolved. Nothing in this comparison depends on it.

A candidate archived source for the otherwise-unavailable alpha was found OUTSIDE the paper extracts: the Pgood file header carries alpha_secret=2 and alpha_error=2. No archived text identifies these with Approximation 4.8/4.9's alpha, so no value was assumed; recorded as a lead for a successor task.

The measurement dips marginally below the model's parameter-free noise floor at the bottom of both bands (see observations_summary.structural_mismatch_at_the_bottom). Unexpected under Model 4.7's D >= 0, tiny in magnitude, recorded rather than smoothed over.

The exponent that the measurement prefers is 2 to 2.5 lower than the archived-integer exponent in both files, corresponding to an effective r of 2.17 and 2.23 in the generalised reading Phi = exp(-(a x^r + b y^r)) against r = 2. Reported as a sensitivity diagnostic of the declared reading of the UNAVAILABLE Phi; Approximation 4.9 is not adjusted by it.

executor_assessment.data_quality_reason: The measurement itself is a single un-replicated third-party archived run set at each of two parameter points, its pooled counting design makes the effective sample size a lower bound rather than a known quantity, and the model's absolute normalisation is not computable from archived bytes. The comparison is nonetheless well-posed over the resolved band and its numerics are self-checked to 1e-15.
